title: From Persona to Personalization: A Survey on Role-Playing Language Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing existing literature on how assigned personas induce implicit biases that degrade language agents' reasoning capabilities (e.g., performance on arithmetic problems) across different demographic contexts.

Surveying studies that measure the political inclinations and stances of Role-Playing Language Agents (RPLAs), noting tendencies towards specific viewpoints like pro-environmental or left-libertarian ideologies.

Analyzing the explicit prejudices and stereotypes elicited when language models are assigned specific historical or toxic personas (e.g., generating discriminatory content when role-playing as a specific dictator or 'a bad person').
